title: Minceraft Always
description: A lightweight resource pack that permanently features the rare “Minceraft” logo on the title screen. In vanilla Minecraft, this typo appears randomly with a 0.1% chance, but with this pack, the Easter egg is always visible.
body:
# 📌 Minceraft Always 

Minceraft Always is a simple but charming resource pack that forces Minecraft to display the iconic “Minceraft” typo on the title screen every single time you launch the game.

In vanilla Minecraft, this easter egg appears with only a 0.1% chance (1 in 1000). That means most players may never even see it naturally. This pack removes the randomness and makes the typo permanent, so you can enjoy one of Minecraft’s oldest and funniest UI quirks without relying on luck.

## ✨ Features
✔ Always shows the “Minceraft” logo

Replaces the normal Minecraft title with Minceraft, matching the original texture exactly.

No flashing, no randomness, no conditions — it always appears.

✔ Preserves the authentic look

Uses the original, unmodified Minceraft logo extracted from Minecraft’s assets.

Same style, same shading, same pixel-perfect detail.

✔ Lightweight & Compatible

Doesn’t modify any gameplay, textures, sounds, or models.

Works with shaders, mods, datapacks, and other resource packs (as long as they don’t also replace the logo).

Safe for singleplayer, multiplayer, and performance-friendly setups.

## 🎯 Why This Pack?

The Minceraft typo is one of those small, funny details that have existed in the game for years.
But unless you're incredibly lucky, you might never see it.
This pack brings that feeling of “oh wow it actually happened!” to your game every time, creating a nostalgic or quirky vibe whenever you open the launcher.

It’s perfect for:

Players who love Minecraft easter eggs

Content creators wanting a fun splash screen

People who want a tiny touch of personality added to their UI

Anyone who enjoys harmless chaos 😄

## 📦 Technical Information

Versions: Works on 1.21 and 1.21.1 (just change pack_format if needed)

Conflicts: None, unless another pack replaces the title logo

## 👍 Simple, Fun, and Zero Impact

This pack doesn’t change how you play Minecraft — just how it greets you.
If you want a clean, simple resource pack that adds a bit of personality every time you load the game, Minceraft Always is exactly that.
